stem:
Haruko did 9 sit-ups in P.E. class. The number of sit-ups Tom did can be represented by this expression.

2 × 9

Which statement is true?

options.label: F
options.text: Tom did 2 times as many sit-ups as Haruko.

options.label: G
options.text: Haruko did 2 times as many sit-ups as Tom.

options.label: H
options.text: Tom did 2 more sit-ups than Haruko.

options.label: J
options.text: Haruko did 2 more sit-ups than Tom.

difficulty_rationale: The problem involves straightforward multiplication and interpretation of a simple expression to identify the correct comparative statement.
